message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling about a "Dynamic Gas Lock Membrane" (DGLM) for ASML EUV lithography machines. Parts of machines for manufacturing semiconductor devices fall under heading 8486. Subheading 8486.20 covers machines for manufacturing semiconductor devices or electronic integrated circuits, and its parts and accessories fall under 8486.90. The relevant HTS number is 8486.90.0000, since the 8486.90 subheading is "Parts and accessories" and the statistical suffix for 8486.20 parts is 8486.90.00 with 10 digits as 8486.90.0000.

{"hts_code": "8486.90.0000", "reason": "The DGLM is a part of an EUV lithography machine used to manufacture semiconductor wafers, so it is classified as a part or accessory of semiconductor manufacturing machines of heading 8486 (subheading 8486.90)."}
